annotation.title_clean: 中华人民共和国国务院令第844号 国务院关于修改《住房公积金管理条例》的决定
annotation.title_en: State Council Order No. 844: Decision of the State Council on Amending the Regulations on the Management of Housing Provident Funds
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 中华人民共和国国务院 (State Council of the PRC)
annotation.summary_en: State Council Order No. 844 amends China's Regulations on the Management of Housing Provident Funds, effective 20 September 2026. It revises contribution, withdrawal, loan and surplus-use rules, raises penalties, adds credit records, voluntary contributions by flexible workers and digitalisation duties. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Expands permitted withdrawals (rent, renovation, property fees) and sets 3-day withdrawal and 10-day loan decision deadlines
Flexible-employment workers and self-employed may voluntarily contribute to housing provident funds
Fines for failing to register raised to 50,000–300,000 yuan
Fraudulent withdrawals/loans barred from fund use for 3/5 years
Mandates digital and intelligent management and nationwide mutual recognition of contribution records
